proposal.reason: Main change is host one-sided RMA operation flow (PutSignal/Signal/WaitSignal) integrated into task planning and launch sequencing, including new RMA task queues and plan lifecycle handling (enqueue). It adds a distinct in-node CE/DMA execution and signal/wait implementation (copy-engine), plus a separate cross-node GIN-proxy/plugin transport path with context/progress/registration logic (gin). It also introduces new public API surface and communicator/window capability semantics (including numRmaCtx, hostRmaSupport, and symmetric-window validation tied to window/LSA behavior), requiring device API ownership review (device-api).
